cards.back: Eating the right amounts of different foods so your body gets all the nutrients it needs.
cards.say: balanced diet. Eating the right amounts of different foods so your body gets all the nutrients it needs.

cards.back: A nutrient that gives you energy. Rice, bread and pasta are rich in it.
cards.say: carbohydrate. A nutrient that gives you energy. Rice, bread and pasta are rich in it.

cards.back: A nutrient for growth and repair. Fish, eggs, beans and meat contain it.
cards.say: protein. A nutrient for growth and repair. Fish, eggs, beans and meat contain it.

cards.back: A nutrient that stores energy and keeps you warm. Too much can harm your health.
cards.say: fat. A nutrient that stores energy and keeps you warm. Too much can harm your health.

cards.back: Nutrients needed in small amounts to keep your body working well, such as vitamin C and iron.
cards.say: vitamins and minerals. Nutrients needed in small amounts to keep your body working well, such as vitamin C and iron.

cards.back: Plant material that helps food move through your gut. Fruit, vegetables and wholegrain bread contain it.
cards.say: fibre. Plant material that helps food move through your gut. Fruit, vegetables and wholegrain bread contain it.

cards.back: Your body needs it to work well. You lose it when you sweat, so you must keep drinking.
cards.say: water. Your body needs it to work well. You lose it when you sweat, so you must keep drinking.

cards.back: A mineral that makes bones and teeth strong. Milk, cheese and tofu contain it.
cards.say: calcium. A mineral that makes bones and teeth strong. Milk, cheese and tofu contain it.

cards.back: A mineral that helps make healthy blood. Spinach and red meat contain it.
cards.say: iron. A mineral that helps make healthy blood. Spinach and red meat contain it.

cards.back: It makes your heart, lungs and muscles stronger and helps you keep a healthy weight.
cards.say: Why do we need exercise? It makes your heart, lungs and muscles stronger and helps you keep a healthy weight.

cards.front: How does regular exercise help your heart?
cards.back: It makes the heart muscle stronger, so the heart can pump more blood with each beat.
cards.say: How does regular exercise help your heart? It makes the heart muscle stronger, so the heart can pump more blood with each beat.

cards.back: Your body grows and repairs itself and your brain rests. Children need about nine to eleven hours a night.
cards.say: Why is sleep important? Your body grows and repairs itself and your brain rests. Children need about nine to eleven hours a night.

cards.back: Keeping yourself and your surroundings clean so germs cannot spread.
cards.say: hygiene. Keeping yourself and your surroundings clean so germs cannot spread.

cards.front: When should you wash your hands?
cards.back: Before eating, after using the toilet, after playing outside and after coughing or sneezing.
cards.say: When should you wash your hands? Before eating, after using the toilet, after playing outside and after coughing or sneezing.

cards.front: Why do we brush our teeth?
cards.back: To remove food and bacteria that cause tooth decay.
cards.say: Why do we brush our teeth? To remove food and bacteria that cause tooth decay.

cards.front: Why does sugary food harm your teeth?
cards.back: Bacteria in your mouth use sugar to make acid, and the acid wears away the hard outer layer of the teeth.
cards.say: Why does sugary food harm your teeth? Bacteria in your mouth use sugar to make acid, and the acid wears away the hard outer layer of the teeth.

cards.back: Poor health caused by not getting enough of the right nutrients.
cards.say: malnutrition. Poor health caused by not getting enough of the right nutrients.

cards.front: What can happen if you eat too much fat and sugar and exercise very little?
cards.back: You may become overweight, which can harm your heart and other parts of your body.
cards.say: What can happen if you eat too much fat and sugar and exercise very little? You may become overweight, which can harm your heart and other parts of your body.

cards.front: Why should you cover your mouth when you cough?
cards.back: So that tiny droplets with germs do not spread to other people.
cards.say: Why should you cover your mouth when you cough? So that tiny droplets with germs do not spread to other people.

cards.front: Why is clean drinking water important?
cards.back: Dirty water can carry germs that cause diseases.
cards.say: Why is clean drinking water important? Dirty water can carry germs that cause diseases.

cards.front: What disease can a lack of vitamin C cause?
cards.back: Scurvy. Oranges, guavas and other fruit contain vitamin C.
cards.say: What disease can a lack of vitamin C cause? Scurvy. Oranges, guavas and other fruit contain vitamin C.

cards.front: What can a lack of calcium cause?
cards.back: Weak bones and teeth.
cards.say: What can a lack of calcium cause? Weak bones and teeth.
